concerns.text: The plan expects the aligned dataset to contain additional fields (e.g., `imf_bz_nT`, `o_fe_ratio`, `he_h_ratio`, `c_o_ratio`, `epsilon`, `newell_flux`) that are **not** listed in `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`. Because the schema sets `additionalProperties: false`, any extra columns will cause schema validation to fail, contradicting the plan’s claim that synthetic data will “match the required schema”. This violates the contract and breaks the data‑model ↔ contract consistency.
